Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O He who possesses the needs of those who ask
And knows the inner thoughts of those who are silent
For every request, You have an attentive ear
O Allah, Your promises are true

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: So I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to fulfill my needs for this world and the hereafter
Verily, You have power over all things
